stock.description: Labixiaoxin Snacks Group Limited, an investment holding entity, specializes in the production and sale of a diverse array of snack items within the People's Republic of China. Its extensive product portfolio includes various types of jellies, such as fruit-flavored, canned fruit, yogurt, and mousse jellies, alongside jelly-based drinks. The company also offers a selection of confectioneries like lollipops, milk and gummy candies, and chocolates. Additionally, it produces fruit and vegetable beverages, powdered milk tea, dried bean curd, and baked goods. These products are marketed under well-known brands including Labixiaoxin, Sunshine City, Humor, and Xiangdoufang. Established in 2000 and headquartered in Jinjiang, China, the company was previously known as China Lifestyle Food and Beverages Group Limited before adopting its current name in June 2012. Labixiaoxin Snacks Group Limited operates as a subsidiary of Alliance Food and Beverages (Holding) Company Limited.
